item.title: 🗣️ Prompt-Aware Speech Scoring System for Second Language Learners
item.description:
Overview

Developed an end-to-end automatic speech scoring system for second language learners that addresses the cold-start problem by incorporating prompt (text and image) awareness. The system was successfully deployed to SANTA Say, a TOEIC Speaking practice app.

Key Achievements

  • Publication: Accepted to InterSpeech 2023 (top conference on audio & signal processing)
  • Production Deployment: Integrated into SANTA Say TOEIC Speaking App
  • Cold-Start Robustness: Achieved reliable performance even with limited training data for new prompts
  • Real-World Impact: Helping thousands of language learners improve their speaking skills

item.title: 📚 Knowledge Tracing with Contrastive Learning (SOTA)
item.description:
Overview

Research project achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on knowledge tracing and student dropout prediction using patch-level contrastive loss. This work significantly improved our ability to predict student performance and identify at-risk learners.

Key Achievements

  • SOTA Performance: Improved AUC from 77% to 88% on knowledge tracing benchmarks
  • Novel Method: Applied patch-level contrastive learning to sequential student data
  • Multiple Datasets: Validated approach across 6 different datasets
  • Deployment Ready: Attempted deployment to SANTA TOEIC App using BentoML

Technical Approach

Knowledge Tracing

Predicting whether a student will correctly answer a question based on their historical interaction patterns.

item.title: 🎙️ Emotional Text-to-Speech (TTS) System
item.description:
Overview

As Research Lead and COO at Humelo, I led the development of next-generation emotional Text-to-Speech systems that could convey nuanced emotions and expressions in synthesized speech. This project was funded by the Ministry of SMEs and startups.

Key Achievements

  • Government Grant: Secured TIPS R&D grant from Ministry of SMEs (S2644149)
  • Publications: Multiple papers accepted to ICASSP (top conference on audio & signal processing)
  • Multi-speaker: Developed systems supporting multiple voices and speaking styles
  • Emotional Control: Fine-grained control over emotional expression in synthesized speech

Technical Innovations

1. Factorized Hierarchical VAE

Developed multi-speaker and multi-domain emotional voice conversion using hierarchical variational autoencoders.

item.title: 🔊 Polyphonic Sound Event Detection with Transfer Learning
item.description:
Overview

Research on detecting multiple simultaneous sound events using convolutional bidirectional LSTMs and synthetic data-based transfer learning. This work addressed the challenge of learning from limited real-world audio data.

Key Innovation

Synthetic Data-Based Transfer Learning:

  • Generated synthetic audio data for pre-training
  • Transferred knowledge to real-world sound event detection
  • Achieved robust performance with limited labeled data

Technical Approach

  • Architecture: Convolutional Bidirectional LSTM
  • Data Augmentation: Synthetic audio generation
  • Transfer Learning: Pre-train on synthetic data, fine-tune on real data

Publication

Seokwon Jeong, *Jungbae Park, *Sang Wan Lee - “Polyphonic sound event detection using convolutional bidirectional LSTM and Synthetic data-based transfer learning” (ICASSP 2019)

item.title: 🧠 Attentional Control for Time-Series Data (Master's Thesis)
item.description:
Overview

My Master’s thesis research at KAIST exploring attentional control methods for time-series data classification and synthesis. This work investigated how attention mechanisms can improve deep learning models’ ability to process sequential data.

Research Focus

Developed novel attention-based approaches for:

  1. Time-series Classification: Identifying patterns and categories in sequential data
  2. Time-series Synthesis: Generating realistic sequential data with desired characteristics

Key Contributions

EEG Signal Classification

  • Applied reinforcement learning for adaptive EEG signal processing
  • Solved the memory-based vs. memoryless trade-off problem
  • Publication: Jungbae Park, *Sang Wan Lee - “Solving the Memory-based-Memoryless Trade-off Problem for EEG Signal Classification” (IEEE SMC 2018, Oral)

Attention Mechanisms for Sequential Data

  • Investigated how attention can focus on relevant time steps
  • Balanced model capacity with interpretability
  • Applications in neuroscience and signal processing

Tech Stack

  • Deep Learning: LSTM, Attention mechanisms
  • Signal Processing: EEG analysis, time-series processing
  • Frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch

Applications

  • Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCI)
  • Medical signal analysis
  • Sequential pattern recognition
  • Temporal data synthesis

Period

March 2017 - February 2019
